# Swift Web Sync

> Swift Web Sync is a digital growth agency specializing in high-performance, mobile-first web development and digital infrastructure for US small businesses, including restaurants, salons, contractors, and studios. We replace slow, vulnerable legacy platforms with lightning-fast static web applications.

## Core Offerings & Pricing
- **Zero-Upfront Prototype Preview:** 100% free live mobile prototype preview before any financial commitment.
- **Custom Static Web Build:** $500 total build fee executed under a 50% deposit ($250) and 50% final launch balance ($250) upon prototype approval and domain deployment.
- **Managed Retainer:** $49/month covering high-performance cloud edge hosting, SSL security, domain/DNS administration, and regular content updates.
- **Turnaround:** 24 to 48-hour prototype delivery model.
